conceptZh: 浣熊助手花生抱著高高的彈力枕頭塔追趕調皮小老鼠時敬禮失手，整個人連同枕頭在房裡高速彈跳碰撞，每撞一下就喀噠一聲拼出「夢」的筆畫，最後彈上字頂打瞌睡並浮現夢見大橡果的泡泡。
object: A wobbling tower of bouncy cloud-shaped pillows and indigo wooden blocks carried by Peanut the cartoon raccoon sidekick
morph: Bouncing stacked cloud pillows and sleepy wooden blocks ricocheting off floor, walls, ceiling, and a cheeky mouse's head to clack into the four layered components of the Traditional Chinese character 夢 (top grass radical 艹, wide net 罒, crown cover 冖, and bottom crescent evening 夕)
creativeAngle: 結合「彈跳連鎖（BOUNCE CHAIN）」與浣熊助手花生愛敬禮卻手滑的個性，讓他在追逐調皮小老鼠時踩中彈力雲朵枕頭，在地板、牆面、天花板與小老鼠頭頂之間連續反彈，每次撞擊都像積木般精準敲出「夢」的各部結構（艹、罒、冖、夕），最後在字頂睡著並浮現「夢見」的趣味畫面。
promptEn:
An 8-second 3D cartoon animation in a bright, warm pastel playroom with a soft cream background and clean, uncluttered staging. No real people—only stylized animated cartoon animal characters.

0.0–1.8s (Want It & Wrong-Time Salute): Peanut, an eager cartoon raccoon sidekick with a striped tail and oversized scout cap, totters across the floor carrying a comically tall, wobbling stack of springy cloud pillows and deep-indigo wooden blocks. A tiny cheeky cartoon mouse with big round ears zips past and waggles its eyebrows. Peanut snaps a crisp salute at the wrong moment—letting go of the towering stack! Audio: A warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin speaks the first utterance slowly and distinctly as the stack begins to tip: "夢 (ㄇㄥˋ)".

1.8–3.5s (Try, Miss & Launch): Peanut dives to catch the falling tower, lands belly-first on the bottom springy pillow, and launches into a wild high-speed bounce chain! Boing—he ricochets off the left wall, knocking two crisp indigo cross-blocks into the upper-center air to clack into the top grass radical (艹). Boing—he rebounds off the ceiling, snapping the four-windowed wide net component (罒) right underneath with a woody clack.

3.5–5.0s (The Big Bonk & Glyph Completion): Caring downward, Peanut bounces gently off the grinning mouse's head with a harmless cartoon BONK and a squash-and-stretch wobble, flinging the wide cover stroke (冖) into the middle, then caroms off the floor to kick the angled crescent evening strokes (夕) cleanly into the bottom base. Every piece locks together into the single complete, correctly proportioned Traditional Chinese character "夢" in saturated deep indigo, centered and filling about 70% of the frame height with generous clean margins. Audio: As the final strokes clack into place, the off-screen voice speaks the second utterance: "夢 (ㄇㄥˋ)".

5.0–8.0s (Final 3-Second Hold & Word Payoff): The finished indigo glyph "夢" holds completely still and razor-sharp in the center for the full final 3 seconds. The final bounce drops Peanut sitting atop the top stroke without covering any part of the character; his eyes swirl dizzily, then flutter shut with a blissful sleepy grin. Audio: Right at 5.5s, the voice clearly pronounces the vocabulary word: "夢見 (ㄇㄥˋ ㄐㄧㄢˋ)"—read with exact Taiwan standard tones, no extra dialogue, and soft whimsical sound effects quieter than the voice. On the word "夢見", a translucent cartoon thought-bubble cloud pops open beside Peanut's head showing a giant sparkling golden acorn spinning inside, while the cheeky mouse tiptoes below and gives a tiny thumbs-up. No subtitles or extra text on screen.
